audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed as Job's answer to Eliphaz: friends as miserable comforters, destructive speech, God as attacker imagery, torn body, clean prayer claim, blood/earth cry, and witness in heaven language.

verses.restored: Job answered and said:

familiar.text: Then Job answered and said,

modern.text: Then Job answered:

original.text: וַיַּ֥עַן אִיּ֗וֹב וַיֹּאמַֽר

verses.restored: I have heard many such things; miserable comforters are all of you.

familiar.text: I have heard many such things: miserable comforters are ye all.

modern.text: “I have heard many things like these; miserable comforters are you all.

original.text: שָׁמַ֣עְתִּי כְאֵ֣לֶּה רַבּ֑וֹת מְנַחֲמֵ֖י עָמָ֣ל כֻּלְּכֶֽם

verses.restored: Is there an end to windy words? What provokes you that you answer?

familiar.text: Shall vain words have an end? or what emboldeneth thee that thou answerest?

modern.text: Is there no end to your long-winded speeches? What provokes you to continue testifying?

original.text: הֲקֵ֥ץ לְדִבְרֵי ר֑וּחַ א֥וֹ מַה יַּ֝מְרִֽיצְךָ֗ כִּ֣י תַעֲנֶֽה

verses.restored: I also could speak like you, if your soul were in place of my soul; I could join words against you and shake my head at you.

familiar.text: I also could speak as ye do: if your soul were in my soul’s stead, I could heap up words against you, and shake mine head at you.

modern.text: I could also speak like you if you were in my place; I could heap up words against you and shake my head at you.

original.text: גַּ֤ם אָנֹכִי֮ כָּכֶ֪ם אֲדַ֫בֵּ֥רָה ל֤וּ יֵ֪שׁ נַפְשְׁכֶ֡ם תַּ֤חַת נַפְשִׁ֗י אַחְבִּ֣ירָה עֲלֵיכֶ֣ם בְּמִלִּ֑ים וְאָנִ֥יעָה עֲ֝לֵיכֶ֗ם בְּמ֣וֹ רֹאשִֽׁי

verses.restored: I would strengthen you with my mouth, and the moving of my lips would hold back your grief.

familiar.text: But I would strengthen you with my mouth, and the moving of my lips should asswage your grief.

modern.text: But I would encourage you with my mouth, and the consolation of my lips would bring relief.

original.text: אֲאַמִּצְכֶ֥ם בְּמוֹ פִ֑י וְנִ֖יד שְׂפָתַ֣י יַחְשֹֽׂךְ

verses.restored: If I speak, my pain is not held back; if I cease, what departs from me?

familiar.text: Though I speak, my grief is not asswaged: and though I forbear, what am I eased?

modern.text: Even if I speak, my pain is not relieved, and if I hold back, how will it go away?

original.text: אִֽם אֲ֭דַבְּרָה לֹא יֵחָשֵׂ֣ךְ כְּאֵבִ֑י וְ֝אַחְדְּלָ֗ה מַה מִנִּ֥י יַהֲלֹֽךְ

verses.restored: Surely now he has worn me out; you have made desolate all my company.

familiar.text: But now he hath made me weary: thou hast made desolate all my company.

modern.text: Surely He has now exhausted me; You have devastated all my family.

original.text: אַךְ עַתָּ֥ה הֶלְאָ֑נִי הֲ֝שִׁמּ֗וֹתָ כָּל עֲדָתִֽי

verses.restored: You have shriveled me; it has become a witness. My leanness rises against me and answers to my face.

familiar.text: And thou hast filled me with wrinkles, which is a witness against me: and my leanness rising up in me beareth witness to my face.

modern.text: You have bound me, and it has become a witness; my frailty rises up and testifies against me.

original.text: וַֽ֭תִּקְמְטֵנִי לְעֵ֣ד הָיָ֑ה וַיָּ֥קָם בִּ֥י כַ֝חֲשִׁ֗י בְּפָנַ֥י יַעֲנֶֽה

verses.restored: His anger has torn and opposed me; he gnashes his teeth at me. My adversary sharpens his eyes against me.

familiar.text: He teareth me in his wrath, who hateth me: he gnasheth upon me with his teeth; mine enemy sharpeneth his eyes upon me.

modern.text: His anger has torn me and opposed me; He gnashes His teeth at me. My adversary pierces me with His eyes.

original.text: אַפּ֤וֹ טָרַ֨ף וַֽיִּשְׂטְמֵ֗נִי חָרַ֣ק עָלַ֣י בְּשִׁנָּ֑יו צָרִ֓י יִלְט֖וֹשׁ עֵינָ֣יו לִֽי

verses.restored: They have gaped at me with their mouth; with reproach they strike my cheek; together they gather against me.

familiar.text: They have gaped upon me with their mouth; they have smitten me upon the cheek reproachfully; they have gathered themselves together against me.

modern.text: They open their mouths against me and strike my cheeks with contempt; they join together against me.

original.text: פָּעֲר֬וּ עָלַ֨י בְּפִיהֶ֗ם בְּ֭חֶרְפָּה הִכּ֣וּ לְחָיָ֑י יַ֝֗חַד עָלַ֥י יִתְמַלָּאֽוּן

verses.restored: The Divine hands me over to the unjust and throws me into the hands of the wicked.

familiar.text: God hath delivered me to the ungodly, and turned me over into the hands of the wicked.

modern.text: God has delivered me to unjust men; He has thrown me to the clutches of the wicked.

original.text: יַסְגִּירֵ֣נִי אֵ֭ל אֶ֣ל עֲוִ֑יל וְעַל יְדֵ֖י רְשָׁעִ֣ים יִרְטֵֽנִי

verses.restored: I was at ease, and he shattered me; he seized me by the neck and dashed me to pieces. He set me up as his target.

familiar.text: I was at ease, but he hath broken me asunder: he hath also taken me by my neck, and shaken me to pieces, and set me up for his mark.

modern.text: I was at ease, but He shattered me; He seized me by the neck and crushed me. He has set me up as His target;

original.text: שָׁ֘לֵ֤ו הָיִ֨יתִי וַֽיְפַרְפְּרֵ֗נִי וְאָחַ֣ז בְּ֭עָרְפִּי וַֽיְפַצְפְּצֵ֑נִי וַיְקִימֵ֥נִי ל֝֗וֹ לְמַטָּרָֽה

verses.restored: His archers surround me; he pierces my kidneys and does not spare; he pours my gall on the ground.

familiar.text: His archers compass me round about, he cleaveth my reins asunder, and doth not spare; he poureth out my gall upon the ground.

modern.text: His archers surround me. He pierces my kidneys without mercy and spills my gall on the ground.

original.text: יָ֘סֹ֤בּוּ עָלַ֨י רַבָּ֗יו יְפַלַּ֣ח כִּ֭לְיוֹתַי וְלֹ֣א יַחְמ֑וֹל יִשְׁפֹּ֥ךְ לָ֝אָ֗רֶץ מְרֵרָֽתִי

verses.restored: He breaches me with breach upon breach; he runs against me like a warrior.

familiar.text: He breaketh me with breach upon breach, he runneth upon me like a giant.

modern.text: He breaks me with wound upon wound; He rushes me like a mighty warrior.

original.text: יִפְרְצֵ֣נִי פֶ֭רֶץ עַל פְּנֵי פָ֑רֶץ יָרֻ֖ץ עָלַ֣י כְּגִבּֽוֹר

verses.restored: I have sewed sackcloth over my skin and thrust my horn into the dust.

familiar.text: I have sewed sackcloth upon my skin, and defiled my horn in the dust.

modern.text: I have sewn sackcloth over my skin; I have buried my horn in the dust.

original.text: שַׂ֣ק תָּ֭פַרְתִּי עֲלֵ֣י גִלְדִּ֑י וְעֹלַ֖לְתִּי בֶעָפָ֣ר קַרְנִֽי

verses.restored: My face is red from weeping, and deep shadow is on my eyelids,

familiar.text: My face is foul with weeping, and on my eyelids is the shadow of death;

modern.text: My face is red with weeping, and deep shadows ring my eyes;

original.text: פָּנַ֣י חמרמרה מִנִּי בֶ֑כִי וְעַ֖ל עַפְעַפַּ֣י צַלְמָֽוֶת

verses.restored: though there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is clean.

familiar.text: Not for any injustice in mine hands: also my prayer is pure.

modern.text: yet my hands are free of violence and my prayer is pure.

original.text: עַ֭ל לֹא חָמָ֣ס בְּכַפָּ֑י וּֽתְפִלָּתִ֥י זַכָּֽה

verses.restored: Earth, do not cover my blood, and let there be no resting place for my cry.

familiar.text: O earth, cover not thou my blood, and let my cry have no place.

modern.text: O earth, do not cover my blood; may my cry for help never be laid to rest.

original.text: אֶ֭רֶץ אַל תְּכַסִּ֣י דָמִ֑י וְֽאַל יְהִ֥י מָ֝ק֗וֹם לְזַעֲקָתִֽי

verses.restored: Even now, look, my witness is in the heavens, and my testifier is on high.

familiar.text: Also now, behold, my witness is in heaven, and my record is on high.

modern.text: Even now my witness is in heaven, and my advocate is on high.

original.text: גַּם עַ֭תָּה הִנֵּה בַשָּׁמַ֣יִם עֵדִ֑י וְ֝שָׂהֲדִ֗י בַּמְּרוֹמִֽים

verses.restored: My friends are my mockers; my eye pours tears to the Divine,

familiar.text: My friends scorn me: but mine eye poureth out tears unto God.

modern.text: My friends are my scoffers as my eyes pour out tears to God.

original.text: מְלִיצַ֥י רֵעָ֑י אֶל אֱ֝ל֗וֹהַ דָּלְפָ֥ה עֵינִֽי

verses.restored: that he would argue for a man with the Divine, as a son of humanity argues for his friend.

familiar.text: O that one might plead for a man with God, as a man pleadeth for his neighbour!

modern.text: Oh, that a man might plead with God as he pleads with his neighbor!

original.text: וְיוֹכַ֣ח לְגֶ֣בֶר עִם אֱל֑וֹהַּ וּֽבֶן אָדָ֥ם לְרֵעֵֽהוּ

verses.restored: For a few years will come, and I will go the path from which I will not return.

familiar.text: When a few years are come, then I shall go the way whence I shall not return.

modern.text: For when only a few years are past I will go the way of no return.

original.text: כִּֽי שְׁנ֣וֹת מִסְפָּ֣ר יֶאֱתָ֑יוּ וְאֹ֖רַח לֹא אָשׁ֣וּב אֶהֱלֹֽךְ
